name: Stella Timeline Plugin
description: OpenClaw timeline runtime with canonical timeline_resolve and timeline_transition, LLM-based temporal reasoning, and guarded append-only writes.

enableTrace.description: Whether Timeline writes trace records for each runtime execution.

traceLogPath.description: Optional trace log path. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace.

canonicalMemoryRoot.description: Root directory for canonical timeline daily logs. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace.

enablePromptTimelineContext.description: Whether to inject timeline prompt context through before_prompt_build.

promptTimelineLookbackDays.description: How many days read_only_fast and prompt timeline context may look back for still-active macro events.

promptTimelineMacroThresholdMinutes.description: Duration threshold above which an active fact is treated as macro background rather than an instantaneous scene.

promptTimelineDirectCurrentStateAnswers.description: Whether active_instant prompt context may authorize direct answers for current-state questions without a full timeline_resolve call.

reasonerTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the internal timeline reasoner subagent, in milliseconds.

reasonerSessionPrefix.description: Session key prefix used for the internal timeline reasoner subagent.

reasonerMessageLimit.description: Maximum number of messages retained when reading the internal reasoner transcript.

sessionHistoryLimit.description: Maximum number of current-session messages retained by the collector.

memorySearchMaxResults.description: Maximum number of results requested when the collector calls OpenClaw memory_search.
